title: Molybdenum induces hepatic impairments via dysregulating NLRP3, JAK1/STAT3 and NF-kappaB pathways: A dose dependent toxicity assessment.
authors: El Safadi, Mahmoud; Alkhoshaiban, Abdulaziz Saleh; Hayat, Muhammad Faisal; Zahara, Syeda Sania; Akbar, Ali; Al-Aream, Maha A; Jamil, Salim; Hassan, Hesham M
journal: Journal of trace elements in medicine and biology : organ of the Society for Minerals and Trace Elements (GMS)
one_liner_zh: 该研究评估钼对大鼠肝脏的毒性作用，涉及氧化应激、炎症和凋亡通路，虽用分子对接和动力学模拟但对象为小分子-蛋白，非蛋白质-DNA互作，与本课题无关。
abstract: BACKGROUND: Molybdenum (Mo) is an important trace element that is documented to instigate several toxicities in different organs of the body. Mo demonstrates adverse effects by inducing oxidative stress (OS), inflammatory damage as well as apoptotic responses in key regulatory organs of the body. AIM: The present experiment was executed to measure the dose-dependent effects of Mo on hepatic tissues of rats by examining histological and biochemical profile. METHODOLOGY: Thirty-six male rats (albino) were segregated into 4 groups including the group I (control), group II (Mo 10 mg/kg), group III (Mo 30 mg/kg) and IV (Mo 50 mg/kg) intoxicated group. The experiment was conducted for 4 weeks consecutively. The gene expressions were measured through qRT-PCR protocol; however, biochemical assessments were carried out via standard ELISA technique along with numerous other standard assays. The findings are further validated through molecular docking (MD) analysis as well as molecular dynamic simulation (MDS) techniques. FINDINGS: Mo intoxication (10 mg/kg, 30 mg/kg and 50 mg/kg) upregulated the gene expression of Janus kinase 1 (JAK1), signal transducer and activator of transcription 3 (STAT3), nuclear factor kappa B (NF-kappab), NOD-like receptor protein 3 (NLRP3), interleukin-18 (IL-18), cyclooxygenase-2 (COX-2), interleukin- 1 beta (IL-1beta), interleukin-6 (IL-6) and tumor necrosis factor-alpha (TNF-alpha). Moreover, an escalation was recorded in the levels of reactive oxygen species (ROS) and malondialdehyde (MDA), however, the activities of glutathione peroxidase (GPx), catalase (CAT), glutathione (GSH), superoxide dismutase (SOD), heme-oxygenase-1 (HO-1), glutathione S- transferase (GST), & glutathione reductase (GSR) following the dose concentration of Mo (10 mg/kg, 30 mg/kg and 50 mg/kg). Besides, Mo exposure (50 mg/kg) escalated the levels of aspartate aminotransferase (AST), gamma-glutamyl transpeptidase (GGT), alkaline phosphatase (ALP) & alanine transaminase (ALT), however, the total proteins as well as albumin levels were decreased. Additionally,Caspase-9, and Caspase-3 levels along with Bax were increased while the levels of Bcl-2 were subsided at all the tested doses of Mo. Furthermore, Mo intoxication (10 mg/kg, 30 mg/kg, and 50 mg/kg) distorted the hepatic morphology. CONCLUSION: Mo is a potent hepatotoxic agent that induces apoptosis, OS along with inflammatory damage in the hepatic tissues at different dose concentrations. These results revealed the toxic nature of Mo at various dose concentrations, indicating the urgent need for a novel therapeutic approach, environmental and regulatory policies to combat these adverse effects.
abstract_zh: 背景：钼（Mo）是一种重要的微量元素，已有文献记载其可诱发身体不同器官的多种毒性。钼通过诱导氧化应激（OS）、炎症损伤以及身体关键调节器官中的凋亡反应来展现不良效应。目的：本实验旨在通过检查组织学和生化指标，评估钼对大鼠肝组织的剂量依赖性影响。方法：将三十六只雄性大鼠（白化型）分为4组，包括I组（对照组）、II组（Mo 10 mg/kg）、III组（Mo 30 mg/kg）和IV组（Mo 50 mg/kg）中毒组。实验连续进行4周。基因表达通过qRT-PCR方案测量；然而，生化评估通过标准ELISA技术以及多种其他标准测定法进行。研究结果进一步通过分子对接（MD）分析和分子动力学模拟（MDS）技术验证。结果：钼中毒（10 mg/kg、30 mg/kg和50 mg/kg）上调了Janus激酶1（JAK1）、信号转导与转录激活因子3（STAT3）、核因子kappa B（NF-kappab）、NOD样受体蛋白3（NLRP3）、白细胞介素-18（IL-18）、环氧化酶-2（COX-2）、白细胞介素-1β（IL-1beta）、白细胞介素-6（IL-6）和肿瘤坏死因子-α（TNF-alpha）的基因表达。此外，在钼剂量浓度（10 mg/kg、30 mg/kg和50 mg/kg）下，活性氧（ROS）和丙二醛（MDA）水平记录到升高，而谷胱甘肽过氧化物酶（GPx）、过氧化氢酶（CAT）、谷胱甘肽（GSH）、超氧化物歧化酶（SOD）、血红素加氧酶-1（HO-1）、谷胱甘肽S-转移酶（GST）和谷胱甘肽还原酶（GSR）的活性则有所变化。此外，钼暴露（50 mg/kg）升高了天冬氨酸氨基转移酶（AST）、γ-谷氨酰转肽酶（GGT）、碱性磷酸酶（ALP）和丙氨酸氨基转移酶（ALT）的水平，但总蛋白和白蛋白水平下降。另外，在所有测试的钼剂量下，Caspase-9和Caspase-3水平以及Bax均增加，而Bcl-2水平则降低。此外，钼中毒（10 mg/kg、30 mg/kg和50 mg/kg）扭曲了肝脏形态。结论：钼是一种强效肝毒性剂，在不同剂量浓度下诱导肝组织中的凋亡、氧化应激以及炎症损伤。这些结果揭示了钼在各种剂量浓度下的毒性特性，表明迫切需要新的治疗方法、环境和监管政策来应对这些不良效应。
